questions.question: Which of the following is correct about magnets?
options: The direction of field lines is from its south pole to its north pole.
The direction of field lines is from its north pole to its south pole.
The direction of the field depends on the strength of the field.
The magnetic field lines are open curves.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The direction of field lines is from its south pole to its north pole.) है।

questions.question: As per the Constitution of India, what is the age criteria for a person to be elected as the President of India?

The person should have completed the age of 58 years.
The person should have completed the age of 35 years.
The person should have completed the age of 45 years.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The person should have completed the age of 35 years.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly describes the vegetation variation between the eastern and western slopes of the Western Ghats?
options: The eastern slopes receive more rainfall, supporting dense evergreen forests, while the western slopes support dry deciduous forests.
The western slopes receive heavy rainfall, supporting evergreen forests, while the eastern slopes, with less rainfall, support deciduous forests.
Both slopes have identical vegetation due to similar rainfall patterns.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The western slopes receive heavy rainfall, supporting evergreen forests, while the eastern slopes, with less rainfall, support deciduous forests.) है।
